name: Card Nav
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; a menu bar that expands into staggered link cards, rebuilt with CSS transitions instead of GSAP so it ships dependency-free.

stagger.description: Delay between each card's entrance, in ms.

radius.description: Corner radius of the bar and cards.

closeOnOutside.description: Close when the pointer goes down outside the navigation.

closeOnLink.description: Close after a link inside the panel is chosen.

a11y: The toggle is a native <button> that carries aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the card panel, so Enter and Space open it like a click.
Esc closes the open panel from anywhere inside the navigation and returns focus to the toggle.
The closed panel is visibility:hidden, so its links leave the tab order and the accessibility tree; without script the panel is always shown.
Every link and the toggle keep a visible :focus-visible ring, and forced-colors mode outlines each card.
